title: Chapter 101 Alliance Lords Meeting
content:
Chapter 101 Alliance Lords Meeting

After Wu Qing's strength improved, he thought that the insect clone could also upgrade its strength to one star after it was upgraded to one star in the brood, so he upgraded the insect clone together.

The Insect clone was resting in the Zerg-occupied city, surrounded by Zerg. With a thought, the Insect clone pupated on the spot and began to upgrade and evolve.

The information network of the Zerg can transmit energy. This can be seen from the evolution of the Hydralisk into the Rogue and the evolution of the Flying Dragon into the Air Guard and Devourer in the game. They are all completed by pupating in situ and do not require special training. Evolve on top of the carpet that transmits energy.

The system also follows this setting. The consumed system resources can be transmitted to the Zerg units that need to evolve through the Zerg information network, and the evolution can be started directly on the spot.

The insect chrysalis squirmed for a while and then split automatically. Wu Qing's insect clone stood up from it. The split pupa was directly absorbed by the biological reproductive equipment on the insect clone.

The evolved Insect clone has no change in appearance. Because it consumes a lot of resources when hatching, its basics are much better than other Insects. After evolving and upgrading to a one-star level, its strength is also the top among the one-star level. existence.

After thinking about it, Wu Qing evolved and upgraded all the ten insect men who were temporarily serving as his bodyguards to one star level.

In this chaotic world, dangers are everywhere. There are very few opportunities for Wu Qing's body to directly go into battle to kill the enemy. The main thing is for the insect clones to go into battle. It is necessary to improve the strength of the clones and the guards around him.

After the strength improvement was completed, Wu Qing made some adjustments to the development of the Zerg territory and went to rest.

…

At dawn the next day, the city occupied by the Zerg, the entire Zerg territory, Daxia Territory and the alliance's territories were all busy again, and began to continue to transport supplies.

The Tengu clan was also busy transporting various supplies, and no one came out to cause trouble. The two sides spent a peaceful day together peacefully.

It was still the same on the third day, allowing Wu Qing to successfully transport the massive supplies stored in the Evil God Camp's base camp back to the Daxia Territory.

In these three days of material transportation, nearly 200,000 people were dispatched every day, as well as all Zerg units that could help with transportation.

The continuous transportation of so many manpower led Daxia to the battlefield area where the camp battles took place, creating a truly spacious avenue.

This avenue passes through the various territories of the alliance and connects the entire alliance's territories.

Wu Qing took this opportunity to let all the major territories in the alliance work together to build branch roads to each territory using the main road as the main road, truly connecting the various territories in the alliance with Kangzhuang Avenue.

This will greatly speed up the circulation of personnel and materials within the alliance, breaking the previous pattern of separate territories within the alliance.

The material transportation is completed, and now there is another question before us, that is, should we continue to occupy the territorial city that the Evil God camp occupied by the Zerg uses as its base camp?

If we continue to occupy it, how will we station troops? How to negotiate with the Tengu clan?

Instead of continuing to occupy it, should we give this territorial city to the Tengu clan in its entirety? Or should we destroy it and prevent the Tengu clan from taking advantage of it?

This territorial city was specially treated by the evil god camp at a great cost. Although the city is not very big, the lord's protection range is particularly large, making it a very valuable ownerless public territory.

"What's your opinion?"

At the mansion in the city, Wu Qing asked questions and asked the opinions of the alliance lords present.

Not only were Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan here this time, but Hu Wei, Shi Gan and the lords from the alliance also rushed over. It was considered a meeting of the alliance lords.

"This place is far away from the alliance and is isolated from the alliance. If you want to defend it, you will need to spend a lot of troops."

"The relationship between the alliance and the Tengu clan is not harmonious, and the Tengu clan is now acting erratically, the alliance will easily be attacked from both sides."

"If a fight breaks out, it will be very difficult to defend this place."

"Of course, looking at it from another perspective, if we can hold this place, it will be equivalent to having an advanced base between the Tengu clan and the Evil God camp."

"It's enough to attract the attention of most of both parties, and perhaps allow the alliance to develop more calmly."

"The various territories of our alliance are too close to the Endless Mountains. They are extremely remote and closed places. Caravans rarely visit them, let alone other people."

"This place specially built by the evil god camp, if managed well, should be able to become a window for the alliance to the outside world."

"Let's weigh it and see how to choose the one that is more conducive to the development of the alliance."

Hu Wei saw everyone's eyes turned to him first, so he was the first to speak.

He simply analyzed the pros and cons and was not the first to express his opinion.

"Then you must stay! If you eat the fat in your mouth, is there any reason to let it go!?"

Meng was the first to stand up and express his opinion. He supported the continued occupation of this territory. This place was really good. Except for being a little far away from the alliance, other conditions were excellent.

Once the Tengu clan has finished moving everything outside the city, a huge city can be built here without investing any luck.

Moreover, this place turned out to be the territory of the evil god camp. The alliance was obtained through war in an honest and fair manner, and there was no problem in terms of law and theory.

This is a rare opportunity. If it is given to the Tengu clan, it will be very difficult to grab another place like this in the future.

If the war with the Tengu clan is not officially launched, the Tengu clan’s territory cannot be seized. If the alliance wants to develop, it can only seize the evil god camp.

“We all know that this is a good place, but with the current strength of the alliance, can it occupy this place?”

“This is originally a large battlefield, with no strategic location to defend, and it is attacked from both sides. Without sufficient troops, it is difficult to defend such a place of four wars.”

Some lords raised objections. With Wu Qing as the biggest model in the alliance, the several big lords did not use their power to suppress others, and everyone still dared to raise opinions.

As long as you make sense, everyone is willing to listen.

So many lords are willing to speak out and express their opinions even if they just want to show off.

"After the previous war, each territory of the alliance has gained something more or less. After a period of absorption and digestion, the strength of the territory will be improved to a certain extent."

"As the strength of everyone's territory increases, the alliance will become stronger. It should not be a problem to allocate some troops to garrison this territory."

"But these troops of ours are just icing on the cake. The real decision of whether we can defend this place depends on the Zerg and Daxia Territory."

The lord brought the topic back to the Zerg and Daxia Territory.

Everyone looked at Wu Qing. No one knew the true strength of the Zerg.

The lords of the alliance understood that Wu Qing and the Zerg were the real uncrowned kings of the alliance.

It's just that Wu Qing is not greedy for power and the Zerg does not cause trouble, which makes these independent territory lords with strong self-esteem feel respected. This is the biggest reason for the increasing cohesion within the alliance.
